hypothesis: The ranked tick-polling, hop and copy costs in the I/O paths are counted from code, and the selected fixes remove them in host models.
narrative: Costs are counted operations or conditional estimates from the code; none is a board latency measurement. Rank 1 UVC MJPEG setup (apps/os/usb-jpeg-native.c:59, drivers/video/a733_video_jpeg_run.c:169): one of 659 ready programming writes per owner pass, about 659 ms if each pass sleeps one tick; fixed for ready programming with a bounded advancing poll, the model completes all 659 writes in one call and samples the pending task-end status once. Rank 2 USB serial/UVC host submissions (apps/board/host_irq.c, drivers/usb/a733_xhci.c): ready steps slept one tick apiece (delayed-register control: 19 startup sleeps, 14 sleeps on ready steps); fixed in host checks, at most 32 ready passes precede a precise wait, IRQs notify the owner directly, noninterruptible startup and deferred GIC acknowledgment use bounded 50 µs retries; the JPEG profile keeps its cadence until decoder readiness/IRQ81 is connected. Rank 3 USB serial TX and mailboxes (apps/os/usb-service.c, apps/os/client.c): one serial TX per endpoint, 512-byte sector copies; partly fixed (EL1 callers submit retained buffers directly; storage and keyboard waiters are notified); EL0 privileged submission and multiple TX tickets open. Rank 4 USB0 device exchange (apps/board/usb0_service.h:79,109; drivers/usb/diagnostic.c:284): up to 200 µs of active polling then a tick sleep, idle service polls every tick; open. Rank 5 SD streaming worker (platform/a733-storage-update/worker.c:45, drivers/storage/sunxi_mmc.c:355, drivers/storage/fatfs_port.c:88): one advance per tick, PIO one 512-byte block per poll gives 512,000 bytes/s at one poll per tick; open, storage writes need separate coordinator review. Rank 6 DMA clients (drivers/dma/dma_service.c:528,328; a733_dma_controller.c:90,260): each request queues to a worker and gets a reply; open, keep the 25 µs masked-region and 250 µs DMA delivery targets. Rank 7 audio kit service (apps/os/audio.c:90,207; capture.c:105): one-tick owner loop; handed to the audio owner. Rank 8 display validation (drivers/display/a733_display_native.c:10,176; apps/dsi-scanout/native.c:270): each full 720p double-buffer walk reads 8192 uncached table words and checks 1810 CPU pages with 3620 AT translations; duplicate walks fixed (validate once per prepare/request/replay; model prepare/start/stop walks fall from 13 to 3; direct replay admission performs one walk); tick-paced replay and per-MMIO checks open. Rank 9 G2D readout (apps/g2d/native.c:220,233; memory.c:22): 32 KiB copied per tick, two 24 KiB guard scans per chunk add at least 48 KiB of uncached reads, a 720p XRGB frame needs 113 copy wakes and at least 5.30 MiB of guard reads; open. Rank 10 small crypto (drivers/crypto/a733_ce_native.c:97,120): a 16-byte AES task maintains 7872 bytes of maximum-sized cache ranges, 492 times its payload; 32-byte random generation maintains 2560 bytes; open. USB follow-ups: reviewed close/drain commit 13897638 consumes endpoint and command completions, finishes port resets, excludes enabled Debug Capability and observes HCHalted within 16 ms; reviewed JPEG commit 3d33b607 supplies decoder INTID 81 wakeups and precise readiness/deadlines and awaits owner-waiter integration; both await integration after the empty-port runs.

hypothesis: The remaining driver families have no tick-polling or copy defect that blocks the real-time targets, or have a recorded action.
prediction: USB owner checks (drivers/usb/a733_xhci.c:73, a733_usb2_native.c:96): each checked MMIO operation performs two provider guards, four time samples and two full-system barriers; provider BUSY can spin up to 2 ms; validate an immutable admission record once. USB decoded-frame lifetime (apps/os/usb-jpeg-native.c:13,34): one frame per image, clears the full 512 KiB input capacity. Codec register path (drivers/video/a733_video_platform.c:223, a733_video_unit.c:327): JPEG's 659 programming writes take 659 lock pairs and at least 1318 DSB SY barriers; registry contention can spin 2 ms. I2C (drivers/i2c/a733_twi.c:46, a733_twi_native.c:57, a733_i2c.c:40): legacy read spins up to 10 ms per phase/STOP deadline. SPI, UART/Bluetooth (headset client has a 250 ms fallback wait), PCIe/NVMe (one pending command), network (one request per tick, at most 1000 requests/s), platform locks (one-tick retries, unbounded CAS in the monotonic counter), runtime (_write calls the platform output once per byte), observation/launch platforms (the latency diagnostic masks interrupts for 5500 µs): open. RTC, PWM, ADC/pins, clock/power/DRAM/watchdog: reviewed, no hot-path fix. GPU, NPU, camera ISP and thermal owners: handed over, unchanged. Application kit (apps/os/application.c, services.c): host-checked, lost or late timer delivery cannot extend the alarm plus service observation window.
conclusion: Findings are code counts without board measurements; the open items are listed in the status file.
narrative: The USB host qualification stream owns drivers/usb/a733_xhci*, a733_usb2*, drivers/usb/host/, apps/board/host_irq.*, apps/os/usb-service.c and the host-class part of apps/os/client.c; the driver real-time stream owns the remaining USB0 findings and the common precise-deadline service (include/sunstone_deadline.h). Host integration bounds health after a lost or late timer IRQ in apps/os/services.c.

hypothesis: The advancing JPEG poll, the USB ready-step waiter and the display single-walk validation behave correctly against stale and delayed hardware status in host models.
narrative: The JPEG check uses the actual executor with a task-end status bit that stays stale until explicit model time advances; completion delays 1, 17 and 2000 µs; a deferred copy stays pending; stuck completion retains its token at the deadline; restoring one-step programming fails the write-count assertion; the shared advancing helper has no sleep, allocation or hardware-wait loop. The USB check executes the actual owner waiter and xHCI core: reset and run status stay stale for 3 ms and 2 ms, command and transfer records arrive after 4.5 ms and 3.5 ms; it covers longer or stuck completion, requests queued after idle, provider contention, the batch limit and deadline retention; restoring the old wait condition fails the ready-step assertion; it does not model physical IRQ entry latency. The display check executes prepare/start and failure paths through the native binding, allocator and IOMMU, checks every frame/table page once per operation, then two-frame replay admission across its phase change; changed IOMMU metadata, lost CPU mappings and corrupted table words refuse the next operation; compiling against the old phase-keyed provider fails the walk-count assertion. The USB-class/JPEG/IRQ OS configuration builds with external applications cleared under usb-jpeg-compile/ (peak child RSS 143548 KiB); the JPEG host check peaks at 112532 KiB; recorded host observations show 114 GiB available, above the 32 GiB reserve. The supervised, resident and resident-audio baselines pass; the selected gate passes kernel, one SMP soak trial, shared helpers, progress, check-index and PMIC/power-domain source checks in 20.89 s with 142584 KiB peak child RSS. Independent reviews approve all three production changes.
